title: Fixture trusted policy plugin configuration (TEST ONLY)
description: Config-seeds an allow-list of principals to host actions for the identity-plane E2E harness. When disabled or the allow-list is empty, every non-session road is denied (default-deny). Never used in production. See openspec change: add-multi-user-identity-plane §11.2.

enabled.description: When false no policy is registered — non-session roads stay ungated (inert).

allow.description: Allow-list entries. A request is permitted iff some entry matches the principal and grants the action.

iss.description: Optional issuer to match. When omitted, matches any issuer for the given sub.

sub.description: Subject (identity join key) this entry grants.

actions.description: Host actions this principal may perform. `*` grants all actions. Omitted also grants all actions.
